beats.text: Colombia receives 3,240 millimetres of annual precipitation. Egypt gets just 18.
Colombia has 180 times the rainfall that Egypt gets.
Egypt is the world's lowest at 18 millimetres.
Precipitation is any water that falls from clouds as a liquid or a solid.
The United States receives 715 millimetres. China hits 645.
Jordan has 111 millimetres, and Mauritania has 92.
